AMIT + JASON

04

What is vibe coding?

You can build a first prototype

without knowing how to code.

You describe what you want. AI writes the code.

“I just see stuff, say stuff, run stuff, and copy paste stuff,

and it mostly works.”

Andrej Karpathy, AI researcher and former Tesla AI lead.

He named it in February 2025: building with AI without reading every line.

You still need to check what it builds.

07

What makes up a good prompt

01

Purpose

Who is it for? What should it help them do?

02

Design

What should it look and feel like?

03

Behaviour

What happens when someone uses it?

04

Constraints

What belongs in this first version?

05

Verify

What must work for us to call it done?

AMIT + JASON

08

Prompt example

PRETEND CODEX CONVERSATION · TEACHING EXAMPLE

Codex

You

Hey, I want to make an app that helps students find our next club event. Make it easy to read on a phone. When I tap “View details”, show me when and where it is. Just one page for now, with made-up details and no login. Check that the right details appear and it works on my phone.

Ask a follow-up…

09

How to iterate

and give feedback

THE ITERATION LOOP

WHAT TO TELL AI

01

Check

Try the main action.

02

Describe

Explain one change.

03

Change

Let AI update it.

04

Recheck

Try the action again.

05

Save

Keep what works.

What happened

What you expected

What to keep

How to check

Change one thing. Recheck it. Save what works.

10

Feedback and iteration

STEP 02 · DESCRIBE: A SECOND MESSAGE TO CODEX

Codex

You

Hey, I set my budget to £150, but a £190 flat still shows up. Only show places within my weekly budget. Keep the layout and shortlist as they are. Try £150 and £200, check the results, then save the working version.

Ask a follow-up…
